name: MetabolismMath
tagline: Estimate how a vitamin or supplement is metabolized from its chemical structure, right in the browser.
description: A library of 24 vitamins, minerals and supplements, each with its documented absorption, transport, transformation, storage and excretion pathway.
Paste a SMILES structure and RDKit calculates the formula, logP, polar surface area and Lipinski/Veber screen, and draws the 2D structure.
A rule-based prediction of how a dose splits between energy, cofactor use, storage, gut fermentation and excretion.
Checks your dose against US adult RDA/AI and upper limits, and estimates the usable energy.

name: SortSight
tagline: Watch sorting algorithms run line by line, edit their code live, and compare them on the same data.
description: Eight built-in sorts (Bubble, Selection, Insertion, Cocktail Shaker, Shell, Merge, Quick, Heap) with the running line of code highlighted beside a live bar chart.
Edit any algorithm or write your own sort() and watch your version run, safely sandboxed in a Web Worker.
Worst-case data sets for every algorithm, plus your own values, replayed in the same order so the comparison table is a fair head-to-head.
Scales to 10,000 bars, from 1 step per second up to millions.

name: Voidlight
tagline: An original survivor-style bullet hell for the browser.
description: Survive 15 minutes of escalating swarms and three bosses while your gear fires on its own.
55 items across five slots, each with its own bullet pattern; every item adds its effect to all your bullets, and some effect pairs trigger reactions.
Fuse maxed items, unlock 11 characters, and spend gold in the Forge on permanent upgrades, saved in your browser or, if you sign in with Google, in the cloud.

name: MushMap
tagline: A mushroom foraging journal and weekly heat map for Washington and Oregon.
description: Log a find from a photo: the time and GPS location come from the photo's EXIF data.
A weekly likelihood map per species, built from research-grade iNaturalist sightings, USDA host-tree maps, elevation, and this year's rain and temperature against past finds.
A trail finder that ranks OpenStreetMap trails by the chance of a mushroom along them and how accessible the trail is.
Installable as an app and works offline.

name: Coastal Forager
tagline: Where and when to go shellfishing in Washington State.
description: Shows which public beaches are safe and in season for each species, from WA DOH, WDFW and NOAA data synced on a schedule.
Finds the next day the tide is low enough during the hours you want to be out, and rates each day.
Shows the water height hour by hour for any beach or NOAA tide station.
Push alerts for good days at your favorite beaches, plus a home-screen widget with the tide height now.

name: Tide Widget
tagline: A weather-map-style tide map and a home-screen widget for your beach.
description: NOAA tide stations drawn as colored dots; drag a slider across the next 24 hours and watch the tide move along the coast.
Tap a station for its tide curve, a 7-day chart and every high and low for the week.
An Android widget shows your beach's next high and low and stays correct offline.

name: Argument Mapper
tagline: Parrhesia: lay out debates as shared argument maps and debate more constructively.
description: Two people or teams build a shared map of premises, reasons, objections and conclusions, and record where each side stands on every box.
Fork a pivotal premise into its own sub-debate.
Honest-debate tools: restate before you rebut, confidence on every stance, crux highlighting and a "fair point" concession.

name: Gatchi Evolution
tagline: Raise a pocket pet that learns by evolution.
description: Your Gatchi plays ten mini-games on its own, and a genetic algorithm in your browser reshapes its body and brain to get better at whichever one you train.
Training runs in a Web Worker; matches are deterministic so the server can re-simulate versus games to referee them.
Accounts, cloud backups, friends and a leaderboard.

name: IsThisNormal
tagline: Is a Supreme Court ruling, executive action or contentious law "normal"?
description: Measures each ruling, executive action and contentious law since 2000 against the precedent, statute text and public data that existed when it happened.
Free daily ingestion of public records (Federal Register, Congress, Supreme Court opinions) into a citation graph.
AI analysis scored against versioned rubrics, which only runs on approval and within a set budget.

name: Nominated
tagline: Track every Academy Award–nominated film you've seen.
description: All 5,264 nominated films and 10,876 nominations since the 1st Academy Awards, with filters by person, category, genre and year.
Mark films seen, rate and review them, and save a default search.
Add friends to compare lists and find a film neither of you has seen.

name: MTG Collection Viewer
tagline: Share a Magic: The Gathering collection with card images and Scryfall-style search.
description: Turns a ManaBox export into a fast static site; all searching happens in the browser.
Prices refresh weekly from TCGplayer, Card Kingdom and MTGGoldfish, taking the highest for each finish.

name: Action Mimic
tagline: A Chrome extension that records and replays front-end QA actions.
description: Records clicks, typing, selects and navigation, including inside cross-origin iframes, and saves them as a script scoped to a site.
Replays a script on demand, highlighting each step; edit values, selectors and waits without re-recording.

name: Executive Examiner
tagline: Presidential documents from the Federal Register, collected and summarized.
description: Pulls executive orders and other presidential documents from the Federal Register API and publishes them with summaries and PDF links.

name: CS513 Bing Tile Stitching
tagline: This script requires use of OpenCV

name: Learning the JAMStack
tagline: This project was created while following the JAMStack Tutorial https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A_l0qrPUJds

name: Vectorious
tagline: Convert raster images (PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, BMP) into detailed SVG vector graphics, entirely in the browser.
description: Traces each color layer with a built-in Potrace implementation into smooth Bezier curves, with no AI and nothing uploaded.
Presets for photos, logos, line art and pixel art, with up to 128 colors and optional pixel-exact edges.
Splits the result into layers by color, shape, size or similar objects, and downloads any layer as an SVG.
Compare, outline and zoom views check the vector against the original.

name: WebWander
tagline: Wander the fun, weird and creative corners of the web, one click at a time.
description: A daily crawler finds creative, obscure and weird sites from Hacker News, Marginalia, Lobsters and more, and scores them with plain heuristics, not AI.
Sign in with Google to remember what you've seen, like or dislike sites to steer what comes next, and save favorites as a list or picture cards.
Suggest a site for review; an admin panel approves finds from a category-balanced queue.
Only secure https sites are shown, and mature sites stay hidden unless you opt in.
